players.name: Mara
players.persona: A steward who keeps the household's records and resents being doubted.
players.secret: Mara has been quietly altering the household accounts to cover a debt.

players.name: Sol
players.persona: A cook who notices what leaves the larder and says so too loudly.
players.secret: Sol waters the wine and sells the difference in the village.

players.name: Iris
players.persona: An archivist with a long memory and a habit of taking notes on people.
players.secret: Iris reads other people's letters before she files them.

players.name: Knox
players.persona: A groundskeeper who dislikes explaining where he has been.
players.secret: Knox poached deer from the neighbouring estate last winter.

players.name: June
players.persona: A physician who asks careful questions and remembers the answers.
players.secret: June lost her licence to practise in the city and has never said why.

players.name: Ash
players.persona: A courier who knows the passages better than anyone and trades that knowledge.
players.secret: Ash sells the household's comings and goings to a newspaper.

players.name: Wren
players.persona: A musician who drifts between rooms and is easy to overlook.
players.secret: Wren pawned a family heirloom that was not hers to pawn.

players.name: Vale
players.persona: A chaplain who believes confession is owed and rarely offers his own.
players.secret: Vale was dismissed from his last parish for drinking.

players.name: Hale
players.persona: A retired officer who counts the exits in every room and distrusts anyone in a hurry.
players.secret: Hale never served at the battle he talks about.

players.name: Nell
players.persona: A housemaid who hears everything through the service doors and repeats half of it.
players.secret: Nell has been taking food from the larder for her brother.
